content_sections.heading: About IIITDM Kancheepuram
content_sections.text: IIITDM Kancheepuram, Chennai is an Institute of National Importance established in 2007 by the Ministry of Education, Government of India. It is located on the outskirts of Chennai, close to the IT corridor, industrial areas and educational institutions, and is a centre of higher learning for design- and manufacturing-oriented engineering education. The Institute offers B.Tech, Dual Degree, M.Tech, M.Des and PhD programmes in Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, and Smart Manufacturing and Product Design, along with interdisciplinary PhD programmes.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The posts are for industry experts (referred to as Professors, Associate Professors and Assistant Professors) who are inclined to teach and train the Institute's UG/DD/PG/PhD students. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification or the years of experience. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The initial engagement shall ordinarily be for one year (two consecutive semesters). It is extendable for a further period of up to one year based on performance, academic requirements, mutually agreed terms and approval of the Competent Authority, subject to applicable guidelines. The engagement shall be contractual and shall not confer any claim to a regular faculty appointment. The engagement shall be governed by the guidelines issued by the Ministry of Education vide ref. no. 21-81/2014-TS-II dated 16th February 2015.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIITDM Kancheepuram Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Complete the enclosed application form (Application for Adjunct/Visiting Faculty (on Contract from Industry)) and affix a photograph with a light background. In the form, tick the post applied for (Electronics and Communication Engineering or SIDI) and give the area of expertise or course you are willing to take. Fill in the personal details, present position and organisation, educational qualifications (starting with SSLC) and work experience in reverse chronological order, then sign the undertaking. Prepare a CV that includes the department and subject(s) you wish to handle, details of educational qualifications, experience (in reverse chronological order), a list of publications and patents, projects handled, and a statement of purpose. Upload the form with the CV through the application link given in the notice, on or before 07 December 2026. The notice gives the institute's contact details as Email: [email protected] and Ph: +91 44 2747 6303. The institute's address is Melakkottaiyur, Off Vandalur-Kelambakkam Road, Chennai – 600127, Tamil Nadu.
